key_insight: DRPG turns past retrievals into reusable policies, helping LLMs avoid repeating the same mistakes as tasks and environments change.
clinical_relevance: For clinical NLP systems, this suggests a practical way to improve reliability over time in evolving workflows such as diagnosis support and medical question answering.
method: Retrieves historical examples from memory and uses them to generate task-specific policies.
Combines retrieval with environment feedback to guide continual LLM improvement.
Tests the framework across multiple benchmarks and model families, including medical diagnosis tasks.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on six benchmarks spanning text-to-SQL, QA, medical diagnosis, and Python programming using seven LLMs; DRPG outperformed strong baselines across most datasets and models.
watch_item: Benefits vary by task, so policy generation may not help equally in all clinical NLP settings and needs careful validation before deployment.
paper_title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement
